title: Fourier expansion
statement: Let $F$ be a complex Fourier system on finite sets $Ω$ and $ι$, with a full-support probability law and an orthonormal basis containing the constant-one function at a distinguished index. For every complex-valued function $f$ on $Ω$ and every $x\in Ω$, $f(x)=\sum_{i\in ι}\widehat f(i)\,b_i(x)$, where $\widehat f(i)$ is the coefficient of $f$ at $i$ and $b_i$ is the $i$th basis function.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a complex Fourier system on finite sets $Ω$ and $ι$
The probability law of $F$ has full support
The basis of $F$ is orthonormal and includes the constant-one function at its distinguished index
